Media tours will occur first, with public access arranged through a ticketing system later. Tickets will likely be priced around Rs 20, while entry for senior citizens and college students will be free. After the public viewing period, a private company will manage the residence for official events.

title: Watch: Anant Singh 'kicks' driver as he greets crowd from SUV sunroof
description: A video of Bihar MLA Anant Singh has gone viral, showing him kicking his driver during a wedding. The incident occurred while he was greeting guests at his daughter's wedding, which has drawn significant attention. His daughter's wedding celebrations included elaborate festivities and invitations extended to attendees from across India and Pakistan. Singh emphasized that all guests were welcome, highlighting the importance of community support.

title: 'Only winter will come': Bangladesh minister doubts Hasina will return in December
description: Bangladesh's state minister for foreign affairs Humaiun Kobir expressed doubt over Sheikh Hasina's reported December return, saying only winter would arrive. He insisted that the former PM could be brought back from India only through the extradition treaty and in handcuffs or under strict surveillance to face trial. Hasina has reportedly sought a state aircraft to return on December 16.

title: Mumbai family pay EMIs for undelivered flat; builder ordered to pay Rs 83 lakh
description: A Mumbai builder has been directed to refund Rs 83.56 lakh to flat buyers due to significant delays. The commission found that construction completion was only about 50% to 60% at the time of the complaint. Flat buyers had not received possession as stipulated in their agreement from February 2019. The buyers faced financial hardships, including incorrect EMI payments that began in August 2020.

title: Bharat Gas distributor told to restore man's LPG connection, pay Rs 20,000 in relief
description: A consumer commission in Andhra Pradesh has ruled in favor of Shaik Abdulla, who faced an unjust cancellation of his LPG connection while relocating to Kurnool. The Bharat Gas distributor charged service fees but neglected to process his transfer request correctly. The commission granted Abdulla compensation for the mental distress and legal expenses incurred due to this mishap, ordering the distributor to reinstate the connection within 45 days.

title: Centre turns up heat on Zakir Naik, gives states sweeping powers to enforce IRF ban
description: The Centre has expanded its crackdown on Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation by delegating powers to state governments. This move allows states to freeze funds and restrict property access associated with the IRF. Following a five-year ban extension on the organization, the home ministry issued a notification detailing these powers. Sections 7 and 8 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act now apply on a state level.

title: Mamata's brother seeks FIR against nephew Abhishek over 'threats'
description: Mamata Banerjee's younger brother Swapan 'Babun' Banerjee approached Kolkata Police seeking an FIR against nephew and TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee, alleging intimidation and obstruction of a blood donation camp. The complaint adds to the family's long-standing feud, which has acquired a political dimension amid Babun's growing proximity to BJP leaders and repeated praise for West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari.

Four family members were found dead, while two boys' fates were dramatically different, with one missing and one surviving. The deceased couple was previously accused of fraud related to an insurance claim about a deceased husband. Police are pursuing multiple suspects connected to the kidnapping and ongoing investigation.

title: Mumbai police issue lookout circulars against CJP’s Dipke, Ranka, Das
description: CJP co-convener Saurav Das was barred from flying to London due to a lookout circular. The Centre informed the Delhi high court that this action was taken at Mumbai police's request. Saurav Das's passport is under scrutiny for several discrepancies regarding his identity. His legal team argued that the travel ban infringes upon his fundamental rights. The court proceedings continue as he prepares to respond to the notice issued.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $325M KC Current helps families in need
description: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' Kansas City Current has extended its impact beyond soccer through community initiatives. In September 2024, the club partnered with Dairy Farmers of America, Harvesters and United Way to distribute 400 gallons of milk and fresh produce. The drive helped nearly 400 adults and children in Kansas City, highlighting the organisation's efforts to support local families facing food insecurity beyond the football field.

title: Man arrested for sexually assaulting 10-yr-old in Delhi park after 7 years in jail
description: A 10-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted by a 35-year-old man in Ismail Khan Wala Bagh. The accused, identified as Rajesh, had a prior conviction for sexual assault against a minor. Locals intervened, restrained the suspect, and alerted the police promptly after the incident. Investigators are examining if the suspect was under any intoxicants during the assault.

title: Jason Kelce's real estate journey from a $680,000 home to a nearly $6M estate
description: Jason and Kylie Kelce's Pennsylvania property expansion reflects their changing family needs as they raise four daughters. What began as a $680,000 home has grown into a nearly $6 million estate through multiple neighbouring property purchases. The couple wanted to remain in their existing neighbourhood while creating more space, privacy and security. Despite facing objections from neighbours, their plans highlight their desire to build a comfortable, stable environment for their children.

title: Jensen Huang and wife’s foundation gains $2.3B in a day, they have donated $425M
description: The reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO has propelled Lori Huang's foundation to new heights, elevating its value to an impressive $9.7 billion, fueled by significant gains in Nvidia's stock. The foundation's philanthropic endeavors have included noteworthy contributions to institutions like Vanderbilt University, positioning charitable giving as a means for strategic investment in future tech innovations. Despite this success, it maintains a low profile in public awareness.

title: Minnesota neighbour posts no-access sign, moors boat; court upholds $64k fees
description: A Minnesota couple sued their neighbour after he put up a sign claiming they had no harbour access and parked his boat along their waterfront, disrupting their attempts to sell two properties. An appeals court ruled that their property titles expressly granted water access, upheld findings of slander of title and nuisance, and confirmed a $64,061 attorney-fee award.
